description: Read-only. Returns room types that fit the stay, with nightly and total NZD rates from public rate plans only. The restrictions rate is for the rate plan's primary occupancy, not the room type's default occupancy. Each adult or child aged 1+ above that base adds the rate plan's extra-person amount per night. Infants under 1 are not counted and are not charged. By default a public title starts with "BAR - "; a non-empty explicit rate-plan id list in config overrides that. A room with no public plan for the stay is no_public_rate. Respects stop_sell, closed_to_arrival, min_stay_arrival, and occupancy. Dates are ISO dates in Pacific/Auckland, check-out must be after check-in, the stay cannot exceed 30 nights, and check-in cannot be in the past. Does not create a booking and does not accept payment card data.

check_in.description: Check-in date YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in Pacific/Auckland.

check_out.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check-in. Maximum 30 nights.

children.description: Number of children aged 1 or over, from 0 to 20. Do not count infants under 1 here.

infants.description: Infants under 1 year. They do not count toward occupancy. One cot is available to hire.
